title: Law to require staff training on immigration-related city policies
summary: This bill would require city agencies, including the Police Department, Correction Department and Probation Department, to train employees, contractors and subcontractors on rules limiting cooperation with federal immigration enforcement. Agencies would also have to publish implementation plans and compliance protocols explaining how staff should handle requests from non-local law enforcement related to immigration. The training and published plans would be required by January 1, 2027.
